Tech lead at Apollo. I work where email, sequences, and agents meet. I helped ship the Claude connector, so a chat can search people, enrich them, and add them to a sequence. The part I keep coming back to is what a model does to a repo once you let it ship.

This site is the long version, after I've sat with it. The first pass is a short take on X. The polished professional version is on LinkedIn.
